rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that rules do not permit an action or participation.

example.jyutping: nei1 dou6 m4 zeon2 sik6 jin1

rows.note: Use this colloquially when a person or authority actively refuses to let someone do something or take part.

example.english: They ban me from using my phone.
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 m4 bei2 ngo5 waan2 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this formal or written verb for official prohibitions, notices, and regulations.

example.english: There is a ban on smoking in this building.
example.jyutping: bun2 daai6 haa6 gam3 zi2 kap1 jin1
